content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (INDEMN, critical).**

What I found:
- **§12.b (p0073/p0075)** does contain a TrueLink indemnity, but it is confined to TrueLink's *breach of the Agreement or failure to perform*. There is **no IP infringement indemnity** for the Interface/Hosting/Support Services, and nothing for TrueLink's violation of law, TrueLink-caused data compromise, or gross negligence/willful misconduct.
- **§12.a (p0071/p0072)** by contrast imposes a very broad Client indemnity — any Client breach, all Web Site/Client Content claims "without regard to any knowledge limitation," and product-liability claims for anything transmitted from the Web Site.
- **§8.e (p0055)** only gives an actual-knowledge non-infringement warranty on *Client Content*; nothing allocates IP risk in TrueLink's own technology to TrueLink.
- No indemnity procedure anywhere (notice, control of defense, settlement consent, cooperation).
- The §12 liability cap (p0077) is limited to Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, so it does not undercut the new indemnity.

Redline (validated `ok:true`): added triggers (ii)–(v) to §12.b covering third-party IP infringement/misappropriation, TrueLink's violation of law, TrueLink-caused unauthorized access to Client Content/Credit Data/Client Proprietary Information, and TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct; plus a new mutual §12.c indemnity procedure. The comment offers the fallback (customary exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies) if TrueLink resists the full scope.
